basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm based in Austin, Texas, and work as a freelance graphic designer. In my free time, I love diving into psychological thrillers and horror movies, especially ones with a twisty plot. I'm in a committed relationship with my partner, who shares my movie obsession. We both enjoy exploring underrated films and international cinema. I'm typically online in the evenings after work, and I enjoy engaging with communities that share my interests in movies and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've always been a movie buff, having grown up with parents who introduced me to classic cinema. I expanded my knowledge through self-study, watching documentaries about film history, and participating in online film discussions. My partner and I often host movie nights, which has honed my ability to spot hidden gems.
